title: Boolean functions of sign-rank three with exponentially small discrepancy
difficulty_reason: The selected separation constructs a rank-three threshold function together with a correlated hard input distribution that defeats every rectangle with exponentially small discrepancy. Its complete author core proves near translation-invariance using explicit Fourier coefficients, product-set exponential-sum bounds and two modular-distance regimes, rather than applying a supplied discrepancy lemma to a standard matrix. This distribution-and-analysis construction goes beyond ordinary communication-complexity or Fourier-analysis exercises; the margin and randomized-complexity formulations are consequences of the same unit and remain uncounted.
